correctness.rationale: For q>=3 every excited vertex at time t was resting and externally triggered at t-1. On a periodic orbit the partwise backward inequalities force one of the three exhaustive indicator regimes: zero, all-time, or complementary-parity. The all-time regime is a pure q-rotation on every vertex. In the alternating regime the two explicit scalar two-step maps have unique m=ceil(q/2)-cycles; surjection onto all m stages is necessary and sufficient to supply the prescribed activity, giving exact period 2m and counts. Finite graph periodicity and inclusion–exclusion close the proof. A separate full-graph enumeration matches every predicted period for 951316 states across 73 triples; this finite test is corroboration only.
